|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4): the Players Committee card image, on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date; the image may be older). It prints word for word the text of [[Faithful Service (V)]] (the original). It is listed as its own version (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The current text is [[Faithful Service (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013.
* '''Original''' ([[Faithful Service (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on table. If opponent is about to remove their last card from Life Force, you may first place all your troopers in Used Pile (last card must still be removed). Your troopers are armor = 4. Your unique (•) [Hoth], [Endor], and [Death Star II] non-pilot warriors of destiny > 1 are troopers. (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=9 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 9, slip 123. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-123-Faithful_Service.png]]) prints slip number “123” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Faithful Service (V) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) moved the trooper sentence to the front, changed “Your troopers are armor = 4” to “Your troopers have armor = 4” and “If opponent” to “When opponent”. PC-E1 text: “Deploy on table. Your unique (•) [Hoth], [Endor], and [Death Star II] non-pilot warriors of destiny > 1 are troopers. Your troopers have armor = 4. When opponent is about to remove their last card from Life Force, you may first place all your troopers in Used Pile (last card must still be removed). (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1210_124-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list drops icons; the [Hoth], [Endor] and [Death Star II] icons are those of the printed slip. The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-faithfulservice-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual1-Light">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/faithfulservice.gif</code>; the directory listing of this folder (Virtual1-Light) was not captured; the captured Legacy folders (Virtual2, Virtual4, Virtual5, Virtual6, Virtual7) all carry 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34, the date the PC rebuilt its image set (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock1-Light/large/faithfulservice.gif</ref>: “Deploy on table. If opponent is about to remove their last card from Life Force, you may first place all your troopers in Used Pile (last card must still be removed). Your troopers are armor = 4. Your unique (•) [Hoth], [Endor], and [Death Star II] non-pilot warriors of destiny > 1 are troopers. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 1 set mark) and prints the number “123” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.

Your unique (•) [Hoth], [Endor], and [Death Star II] non-pilot warriors of destiny > 1 are troopers. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word.
